verdict.rationale: Persona's API clearly covers core end-user actions—pre-creating inquiries, retrieving verification/report data, webhooks, sandbox testing—that parallel what a user does via the Hosted/Embedded UI flows (persona-docs-18, persona-docs-27, persona-docs-33). However, higher-level configuration surfaces like Workflows, Inquiry Templates, and Cases are described as being built/managed through Persona's dashboard UI with no documented API for creating or editing them (persona-docs-5, persona-docs-43), suggesting parity is incomplete. missing for 10: API endpoints/docs for programmatically creating or editing Workflows, Inquiry Templates, and Cases; independent confirmation that all dashboard-configurable features have API equivalents.
